arms.B1_raw_latest: Latest source values only plus account size.
arms.B2_pit_recency: B1 + point-in-time lifecycle/recency descriptors and instance counts.
arms.B3_factsheet: B2 + full FactSheet reducers (max/mean/sum/delta/slope) and stage facts.
arms.B4_decay: B3 + stage-aware decayed scores and account roll-ups.
arms.B6_icp: B5 + ICP conditioning (current engine feature set).
arms.C_latest_only: B6 with numeric reducers restricted to `latest` (no max/mean/delta/slope).
arms.C_missingness_only: Only which signal families are observed (instance counts, coverage roll-ups, size); if this matches B6 the proxy label is population identification, not timing.
arms.C_no_sba: B6 without any SBA-derived feature (labels unchanged).
arms.C_no_stage: B6 with state/stage tracking removed from every signal definition.
arms.C_sequence_reversed: B6 with every sequence rule's order reversed.
arms.C_shuffled_labels: B6 features, training labels permuted (must fall to chance).
arms.C_shuffled_timestamps: B6 features on history with per-account timestamp permutation (labels unchanged).
